tiles.title: Requests
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) AS requests FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: Success Rate
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(span_status_code, 0) <> 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: Errors
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) AS errors FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: Total Tokens
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) + CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS total_tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: Recorded Cost
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.cost" AS DOUBLE)), 0), 8) AS cost_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: Average Latency
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0), 3) AS avg_latency_s FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: P95 Latency
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_latency_s FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: Active Models
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "gen_ai.request.model") AS active_models FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: Requests and Errors Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, 'requests' AS series, COUNT(*) AS value
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY time_bin
UNION ALL
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, 'errors' AS series, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) AS value
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY time_bin
ORDER BY time_bin, series

tiles.title: Request Volume by Model
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') AS model, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY time_bin, COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') ORDER BY time_bin, model

tiles.title: Requests by Provider
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider, 'unknown') AS provider, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider, 'unknown') ORDER BY requests DESC

tiles.title: Errors by Provider
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider, 'unknown') AS provider, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) AS errors FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider, 'unknown') ORDER BY errors DESC

tiles.title: Reliability by Workload
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(workload, 'unclassified') AS workload, COUNT(*) AS requests, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE span_status_code = 2) AS errors, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(span_status_code, 0) <> 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS success_rate_pct FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY workload ORDER BY requests DESC

tiles.title: Latency Percentiles Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, 'p50' AS series, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.50), 3) AS value
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY time_bin
UNION ALL
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, 'p95' AS series, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 3) AS value
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY time_bin
UNION ALL
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, 'p99' AS series, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.99), 3) AS value
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY time_bin
ORDER BY time_bin, series

tiles.title: Latency by Model
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') AS model, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0), 3) AS avg_s, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_s FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') ORDER BY p95_s DESC

tiles.title: Latency by Workload
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(workload, 'unclassified') AS workload, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0), 3) AS avg_s, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_s FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY workload ORDER BY p95_s DESC

tiles.title: Slowest Requests
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_name, "gen_ai.request.model" AS model, COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider, 'unknown') AS provider, workload, complexity, ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 3) AS duration_s, CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) + CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS total_tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY span_duration_ns DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.title: Input Tokens
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS input_tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: Output Tokens
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS output_tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: Avg Tokens / Request
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) + CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS avg_tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: Avg Cost / Request
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST("gen_ai.usage.cost" AS DOUBLE)), 8) AS avg_cost_usd FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1

tiles.title: Token Usage Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, 'input_tokens' AS series, COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS value
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY time_bin
UNION ALL
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, 'output_tokens' AS series, COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS value
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY time_bin
ORDER BY time_bin, series

tiles.title: Cost Over Time
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute', p_timestamp, '1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin, 'cost_usd' AS series, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.cost" AS DOUBLE)), 0), 8) AS value
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY time_bin
ORDER BY time_bin, series

tiles.title: Tokens and Cost by Model
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') AS model, COUNT(*) AS requests, COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS input_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS output_tokens, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(CAST("gen_ai.usage.cost" AS DOUBLE)), 0), 8) AS cost_usd, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0), 3) AS avg_latency_s FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

tiles.title: Model Distribution
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') AS model, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') ORDER BY requests DESC

tiles.title: Provider Distribution
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider, 'unknown') AS provider, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider, 'unknown') ORDER BY requests DESC

tiles.title: Workload Distribution
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(workload, 'unclassified') AS workload, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY workload ORDER BY requests DESC

tiles.title: Complexity Distribution
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE(complexity, 'unclassified') AS complexity, COUNT(*) AS requests FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY complexity ORDER BY requests DESC

tiles.title: Model Performance
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') AS model, COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider, 'unknown') AS provider, COUNT(*) AS requests, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(span_status_code, 0) <> 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS success_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0), 3) AS avg_latency_s, ROUND(APPROX_PERCENTILE_CONT(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 0.95), 3) AS p95_latency_s, ROUND(AVG(CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) + CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS avg_tokens FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown'), COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider, 'unknown') ORDER BY requests DESC

tiles.title: Recent AI Gateway Requests
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_span_id, span_name, "gen_ai.request.model" AS model, COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider, 'unknown') AS provider, workload, complexity, source, ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 3) AS duration_s, CAST("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS input_tokens, CAST("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens" AS DOUBLE) AS output_tokens, ROUND(CAST("gen_ai.usage.cost" AS DOUBLE), 8) AS cost_usd, span_status_code FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Recent Errors
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT p_timestamp, span_trace_id, span_name, "gen_ai.request.model" AS model, COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider, 'unknown') AS provider, workload, complexity, span_status_message, ROUND(span_duration_ns / 1000000000.0, 3) AS duration_s FROM $traces_dataset WHERE span_status_code = 2 AND 1=1 ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Trace Summary
tiles.chartQuery: SELECT span_trace_id, MIN(p_timestamp) AS started_at, COUNT(*) AS spans, ROUND(SUM(span_duration_ns) / 1000000000.0, 3) AS summed_duration_s, MAX("gen_ai.request.model") AS model, MAX(COALESCE("gen_ai.model.provider", "gen_ai.provider.name", provider)) AS provider, MAX(workload) AS workload, MAX(span_status_code) AS max_status_code FROM $traces_dataset WHERE 1=1 GROUP BY span_trace_id ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 100
